text:
morgan: planning a canary for kernel v2.14 + quant profile q1.2 on dedicated-us-west next Tue 10:00 PT. canary will be ~5% traffic across 10 nodes. need quick sanity plan, owners, and rollback readiness. who can own the rollout?
raul: I can own rollout/rollback. Need final canary config and a short smoke checklist to sign off.
samir: I can monitor perf and run the small eval set during the window. will track p95, p99, errors, and a small quality pass. :eyes:
jen: quick q — any model binary changes or just the quant profile? If weights are the same we just need kernel compatibility tests (int8 paths). also need model version pin in the canary config.
morgan: no model weight changes, just quant profile q1.2 (re-tune for tighter activation scaling). will pin model to model@v2.1. config draft below:
```
canary:
  cluster: dedicated-us-west
  nodes: 10
  traffic_pct: 5
  kernel: v2.14
  quant_profile: q1.2
  model: model@v2.1
  fallback: model@v2.0
```
olivia: proposing smoke checklist (short):
- dry deploy (no traffic) and run smoke/small (50 prompts) for output diffs
- perf run (concurrency 8, duration 60s) measure p95 and qps
- KV cache warmup test for stateful sessions
- error budget and alert thresholds set (see below)
commands I'll use:
```
rictl deploy --cluster dedicated-us-west --tag canary-1965432100 --dry-run
rictl smoke --suite smoke/small --target canary-1965432100
rictl perf --concurrency 8 --duration 60 --target canary-1965432100
rictl prime --target canary-1965432100 --script priming/cha­t_warmup.py --concurrency 16 --duration 30s
```
jen: rollback plan to keep in runbook: previous stable tag is stable-2025-07-01. rollback command: `rictl rollback --cluster dedicated-us-west --to stable-2025-07-01` Also add healthcheck that verifies model tokenization parity and a small checksum hash on a known prompt set.
raul: monitoring thresholds I'll watch:
- response error rate > 0.5% -> investigate
- p95 increase > 25% vs baseline -> consider rollback
- quality regression on eval set > 3% (automated) -> rollback
If any trigger hit, I'll initiate rollback and ping #oncall + @samir + @morgan.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by morgan for 2025-07-15 17:00Z (canary-1965432100)
samir: will run the sample evals after dry deploy and during 5% traffic. i'll post diffs in thread and paste a quick summary table. if jitter or p95 spikes, i'll call it.
morgan: PR for infra config and kernel bump is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 — please review, especially the quant_profile mapping. pinging @jen for the kernel config change approval. :wave:
jen: looking now, will try to approve by EOD. small doc nit about the fallback comment.
olivia: I'll own correctness checks and sample output diffs. Samir owns perf metrics. Raul owns rollout/rollback ops.
raul: I'll be online 09:30-12:30 PT during the window. if anyone needs a hand earlier for validation or rehearsals, ping me.
morgan: thanks all — I'll update calendar invite and add runbook snippet. final ask: if anyone wants to rehearse a dry run tomorrow, drop times and we can do a 20m rehearsal. :thumbsup:
jen: 11:00 PT works for me for a dry run rehearsal.
samir: 11:00 PT works.
olivia: I'll join.
morgan: cool, rehearsal booked. will post the rehearsal checklist and small script link in a follow-up. thanks!
